memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `kimi --help` lists `--add-dir <dir>` (repeatable), `-m/--model`, `--auto` (Never Ask mode) and `-y/--yolo`, and describes `-c` as continuing 'the previous session for the working directory'. ~/.kimi-code/sessions holds wd_<basename>_<hash> directories and ~/.kimi-code/session_index.jsonl records a workDir per session, so the key is the cwd.

composer.note: Measured 2026-09-09 against tmux 3.4 with `tmux display-message -p -t <pane> '#{C/r:<pattern>}'`, which answers the matching line number or 0. Kimi draws its composer as a box: the input line is U+2502, a space, `>`, padding, and a closing U+2502. Live idle pane %40 answered 14; a pane rendering `│ > read inbox 001  │` answers 0. The left box character is REQUIRED here (no `?`), unlike claude's, because that is what kimi actually renders. kimi still has no ready.tmux_pattern — it comes up on a fixed delay — and this field deliberately does not become one: readiness and composer-emptiness are separate questions and are declared separately.

bootstrap_message: Read {{bootstrap_file}} and follow it exactly. Reply with the single word READY once you have read it and every skill it lists.
notes: --auto is Never Ask mode; -y/--yolo is the milder Ask When Needed. auto_approve uses --auto because the launcher cannot answer a prompt. Coordinator form UNVERIFIED: `kimi --help` lists `--plan` ('Start in plan mode') which is the likely candidate, but the help does not state that plan mode is read-only, so it is not claimed here.
